about: Outcomes of the full chaos suite run locally (Docker on a laptop). Copied from the README's chaos table, which links each test; the dev log records what each run found. CI re-runs 01 and 04 on every showcase run (see results/latest.json).

runs.broken: SIGKILL bronze mid-batch x3, plus a crash right after the Delta commit
runs.recovery: Replay skipped by Delta txnVersion; every Kafka offset in bronze exactly once

runs.broken: Debezium (Kafka Connect) down while the source keeps changing (ran 180 s; default 600 s)
runs.recovery: Replication slot retained the WAL; CDC resumed and silver reconciled 100%

runs.broken: ADD COLUMN ... DEFAULT on a live source table
runs.recovery: Found that metadata-only DDL emits no CDC for existing rows; the procedure is ALTER + backfill

runs.broken: Malformed Kafka records plus a row that violates a DQ rule
runs.recovery: Each record quarantined with its exact reason; streams never stopped

runs.broken: Every silver table dropped, rebuilt from bronze alone
runs.recovery: Needed the bronze schema archive and a delete-repair backfill; reconciled 100%

runs.broken: Full backfill (341k rows) during live CDC
runs.recovery: Unpartitioned MERGE targets conflicted on every commit; fixed with a retry budget and pacing; reconciled 100%
